prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need. To recommend the right St. Louis branding agency I need to know a few things. Quick questions:

- What’s your primary goal? (full brand strategy & naming, visual identity, packaging, web, campaign creative, internal brand work, etc.)
- Industry / target audience (B2B, B2C, nonprofit, healthcare, consumer goods)?
- Budget range (ballpark) and timeline?
- Do you require a local agency for in-person meetings or is remote OK?

If you want to move forward right away I can:
- Research and return a ranked shortlist of 4–6 St. Louis agencies with links, signature projects, and estimated costs; or
- Give a short list now based on general reputation.

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use this checklist and these interview questions.

Checklist for choosing a branding agency
- Strategy-first: they ask about business goals, audience, positioning—not just visuals.
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry or comparable challenges.
- Portfolio quality: strong visual identity, clear before/after, measurable results.
- Full-service vs. specialist: confirm they can deliver everything you need (naming, identity, guidelines, digital, activation).
- Process transparency: timeline, milestones, stakeholder involvement.
- Team fit: senior involvement and who will do day-to-day work.
- References and results: client references and KPIs they improved (awareness, conversions, sales).
- Budget clarity and scope control: fixed fees vs. hourly, change-order process.

Key interview questions to ask agencies
- Can you show 2–3 brand projects like ours and explain the outcomes?
- What is your strategic process from discovery to launch?
- Who will be on our account and how much senior time is included?
- How do you measure brand success?
- What deliverables and brand assets will we receive?
- What is your typical timeline and cost range for this scope?
- Can you provide client references?

Red flags
- No case studies or measurable outcomes.
- Focus only on logos/design without brand strategy.
- Vague pricing or no written scope/contract.
- No senior involvement or constantly changing teams.

Tell me your goals, industry, budget and timeline and I’ll pull a concise, ranked shortlist of St. Louis branding agencies (with portfolio links and estimated pricing) for you. Which would you prefer?
